name: Cezar
description: Follows the projects of one or more Cezar cockpits live: what is running now and whether anything failed.

settings.title: Cockpits
settings.description: One cockpit per line: its address, optionally followed by comma-separated projects (none = every project). Login: netrc (~/.config/cezar/netrc, ~/.netrc), the keychain item cezar:<host>, or one saved in the panel.

settings.title: Full reload every (min)
settings.description: Changes arrive live from the cockpit's event stream; the full run list (large) is fetched only this often and after the stream drops.

settings.title: Failure window (h)
settings.description: Failed runs that ended within this time are shown as problems.

settings.title: Notify about problems
settings.description: On a new failed run, a run asking a question, and a run held by an account usage limit.

settings.title: Notify when a run finishes
settings.description: A desktop notification for every run that ends successfully, with its duration and merge request.

settings.title: Explain with agent
settings.description: The agent Orca starts when you press "Explain" on a run (claude, codex, ...). It opens in the workspace of the run's repository.

settings.title: Explain prompt
settings.placeholder: Explain what is happening with Cezar run {url} ...
settings.description: The prompt of an "Explain" session; empty = a built-in one, sent through the Cezar cockpit skill when you have one installed (~/.claude/skills, ~/.agents/skills, a Claude Code plugin) or the workspace has one (a skill with "cezar" in its name and "cockpit" in its name or description). {url}, {title}, {project}, {cockpit} and {run} are filled in; {title} comes from the issue, so anyone who files issues writes it.
